rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claims 5 and 6 (ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-008, -p1-009): the prototype wins by default and only a DR1 judgement on the same difference overrides it; DR1 inc-122 (document-dr1-parity-backlog-p8-016) is not a judgement against the link but a deferral that holds only until the address-book slice settles where it goes, and DR2.1 settles that: the link goes to the transporter's address-book view (prototype-dr2-1-source-p7-026), and this programme already adopts transporter entries in the address book (req-461 to req-463), so the deferral's condition is met and the prototype default stands.
outcome: Build DR2.1's 'View details' link on each transporter row, with the transporter's name as visually hidden text, going to that transporter's entry in the INS address book and carrying a return to the transporter list. DR1 (inc-122) only deferred the link until the address book settled where it would go; DR2.1 names that destination and this programme adds transporter entries to the address book, so the link is built in an increment after the address book holds transporter entries. Until then the list carries no action column.
